parameters.content:
## CR Showcase — the whole autonomy loop on ONE canvas
Five production workflows (wf-cr-0..4) compressed into one canvas so judges can watch the full
**notice → verify → decide → act → learn → report** loop execute live.

**Run it:** press *Test workflow*, or `curl -X POST https://knreddy.app.n8n.cloud/webhook/showcase/cr/loop`

Five scenarios fire in one run:
**A** two-voice change → PUBLISH artifact committed to GitHub + learner card on Telegram
**B** one-voice claim → ESCALATE (insufficient corroboration)
**C** prompt-injection source → ESCALATE (safety rule R2)
**D** revert gate satisfied (quiz_delta −0.12 @ n=7, 53h) → REVERT
**E** stuck learner (consent=true, wrong×3) → micro-lesson dispatch

Everything real: LLM judges via Apify TokenFactory, commits via GitHub Contents API, notifications via Telegram bot. POLICY is the production rulebook (9.1KB, kept identical to app/n8n/policy_node.js) — models propose, code decides.

### SCAN (wf-cr-0 compressed)
Source plan (SOURCE-PLAN.md §1) → fetch → sha256 normalize → dedupe via workflow static data → receipt.
Fixture snapshots keep the demo fast; the real crawl is `apify~website-content-crawler` (verified 34s,
257KB markdown from docs.n8n.io/release-notes) — swap FETCH to the HTTP Request "Apify sync run" when live.

### TRIAGE (wf-cr-1 compressed) — models propose, code decides
Engine DecisionInputs route **straight to POLICY** (WIRING §3.0). Scan snapshots go the full chain:
SANITIZE (injection patterns stripped before any model call) → OBSERVE (claim extraction) →
ANCHOR QUOTES (verbatim-quote gate: claims must appear in the cached snapshot) → JUDGE (closed
questions, JSON-only) → **POLICY** — the deterministic rulebook. R1–R9, first match wins, no network,
no clock, no randomness. Refusals queue for a human — never silently dropped.

### ACT (wf-cr-2 compressed)
Only PUBLISH/REVERT survive this lane. v+1 lesson body rendered from the anchored edit → unified diff →
**real commits** to knarayanareddy/Courserefresh under showcase/ via the GitHub Contents API →
learner card to the consented cohort (Telegram) — PUBLISH only, never on reverts.

### LEARN (wf-cr-3 compressed)
Real gate maths in code: n≥5, window≥48h, quiz_delta≤0 → REVERT. Stuck detection: consecutive_wrong≥2
+ consent + notify caps → micro-lesson (1 concept, 2 min, opt-out). Unmeasured stays unmeasured.

### REPORT (wf-cr-4 compressed)
Collects this execution's receipts → refusals first → ≤4KB render (trims oldest, never refusals) →
chain verification (DIGEST FAILED banner if any row is off) → Telegram → final JSON response.
